title: Position enters after projection
purpose: Trace Q and K through RoPE while preserving the value activation.
contract: One token; Q [Hq,Dh], K and V [Hkv,Dh]; F32 activations.
Standard RoPE rotates Q and K at the same logical token position; it does not rotate V.
